x-k-k1-01.title: Wace alama ce ke kaiwa filin ajiye mota?
x-k-k1-01.topic: Karanta Hangul a kan alamun hanya
x-k-k1-01.goal: Karanta alamun hanya gajeru uku, haɗa kalmomi da kibau da alamun da aka bayyana, sannan ka tantance wanne ne da gaske ke jagorantar baƙo zuwa wurin ajiye mota; kare hukuncinka daga rabin fahimtar aboki.
x-k-k1-01.material:
Wani baƙo ya tuka zuwa makaranta kuma yana son barin motarsa na sa'a guda. Alamomi uku suna gani (babu hoto, an bayyana su da kalmomi).

Alama A: fararen haruffan “주차 금지” a kan allon ja. Da'irar ja mai layin karkace ta rufe ƙaramin zanen mota. An kafa ta a shingen makaranta.
Alama B: allon shuɗi, fararen haruffan “방문자 주차장” da kibiya tana nuna dama. Tana gefen hanya.
Alama C: allon kore, fararen haruffan “주차장 출구” da kibiya tana nuna komawa hanya. Tana saman ƙunƙuntar lamba inda motoci ke fita.

Kalmomi: 주차(장) = ajiye mota (filin ajiye motoci); 방문자 = baƙo; 입구 = ƙofa/shigarwa; 출구 = fita.
x-k-k1-01.thinking.0: Haɗa kalma, alama da kibiya a matsayin hujja
x-k-k1-01.thinking.1: Kada ka tsaya kan kalmar da ka saba gani ɗaya (주차장)
x-k-k1-01.thinking.2: Amsa wa aboki da hujjar da ke alamar
x-k-k1-01.prereq.0: Yana iya karanta baƙaƙen Hangul da murya
x-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Ya san cewa kibiya a alama tana nuna hanyar tafiya
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Wace alama ya kamata baƙon ya bi domin ya ajiye mota?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jera abin da kowace alama ta faɗa da kalmomi, da abin da alamarta ko kibiyarta ta ƙara.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowace alama ka tambayi: tana tura mota ciki, waje, ko babu inda?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: 주차장 yana cikin wannan alamar, amma kalmomi biyu ne kawai. Duba abin da kalma ta biyu da kibiya suka ce game da inda motoci ke tafiya.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan alama ma tana da 주차. Duba da'irar ja mai layi: me irin wannan alama ke nufi yawanci?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka haɗa kalmar baƙo, kalmar filin ajiye mota da kibiya. Haka ake karanta alama gaba ɗaya.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Alama B ko Alama C; dukkansu suna da 주차장 kuma kibiya
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: Hakika dukkansu suna da 주차장 da kibiya, amma duba abin da kalmar sauran ta Alama C da alkiblar kibiyarta suke nufi.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Alama B ta shafi baƙi, tana nuna filin ajiye motoci kuma tana ba da hanya. Alama A tana da kalma ta farko iri ɗaya amma alamar hana shiga ce. Alama C ma tana nuna filin ajiye motoci, amma 출구 na nufin fita, saboda haka tana nuna inda motoci ke fita.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Aboki ya ce: “Alama C tana da 주차장, mu shiga ta nan.” Amsa wa abokinka da jimla ɗaya ko biyu da Turanci, ta amfani da abin da alamar ta faɗa da gaske.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Wace kalma ce a Alama C ta bambanta da ta Alama B?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Motoci suna tafiya ina a layin da ke da alamar fita?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Na yi amfani da kalmar alamar a matsayin hujja, ba ra'ayina kawai ba?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Na faɗi abin da alamar ke nufi (fita) da abin da muke buƙata maimakon haka?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Abokina zai san inda zai duba na gaba?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Alama C ta ce 출구, ma'ana fita. Motoci suna fita ta nan, don haka ya kamata mu nemi hanyar shiga, kamar kibiyar Alama B.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.0: Ya ambaci muhimmiyar kalma da ƙofar shigarwa da ta ɓace.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 주차장 rabin bayanin ne kawai. Kalmar ɗaya, 출구, tana nuna motoci suna fita daga nan; saboda haka muna tafiya ta hanyar da ba daidai ba.

x-k-k1-07.topic: Karanta Hangul a kan alamun hanya
x-k-k1-07.title: Yaushe za ka iya shiga ɗakin karatu?
x-k-k1-07.goal: Karanta sanarwa mai layuka da dama, ka yanke shawarar layukan da suka shafi wata rana, sannan ka nemo lokutan zuwa da dama da suka cika duk sharuɗɗan.
x-k-k1-07.material:
Sanarwa a ƙofar ɗakin karatu (layi ɗaya a kowane jere):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Kalmomi: 오전 = safe; 오후 = yamma; 낮 = tsakiyar rana; 쉬어요 = (yana) hutawa; ~ ana karanta shi 'zuwa' (daga ... zuwa ...). Kana son ziyara ranar Laraba.
x-k-k1-07.thinking.0: Zaɓar layukan sanarwar da suka shafi
x-k-k1-07.thinking.1: Nemo mafita da dama tsakanin iyaka biyu
x-k-k1-07.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa wasu lokuta ba su dace ba
x-k-k1-07.prereq.0: Yana iya karanta Hangul da lambobi masu 시
x-k-k1-07.prereq.1: Ya san 오전 safe ne, 오후 kuma yamma ne
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.prompt: Wadanne layukan sanarwar suka shafi ziyarar ranar Laraba? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi tambaya: shin ya shafi Laraba?
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Layi ɗaya suna ne; wani kuma ya shafi wata rana.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan sunan wurin ne; ba ya takaita lokacinka.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka ga cewa wannan layi yana nuna sa'o'in rana ta yau da kullum.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka ga cewa wurin yana tsayawa na ɗan lokaci cikin yini.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan layi game da Lahadi ne; ranarka Laraba ce.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.explain: Layuka na 2 da na 3 suna aiki a kowace rana ta yau da kullum. Layi na 1 suna ne, layi na 4 kuma na Lahadi ne kawai.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.prompt: Nemo lokuta uku dabam-dabam na Laraba da za ka iya zuwa alhali ɗakin karatu a buɗe yake. Kowane lokaci yana da tsarin 'h:30'; shigar da awa h a agogon sa'o'i 24 (1 p.m. = 13).
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta lokutan buɗewa da rufewa da lambobin sa'o'i 24.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cire lokacin hutu, sannan ka gwada lambobinka.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.var.h: awa h na lokacin isowa h:30 (0-23)
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Yi amfani da cikakkiyar awa, kamar 10.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ɗakin karatu yana buɗe daga 9:00 zuwa 18:00; saboda haka h:30 dole ne ya kasance cikin wannan zangon.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Da ƙarfe 12:30 ɗakin karatu yana hutawa.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.explain: Lokutan zuwa masu yiwuwa su ne 9:30 zuwa 11:30 da 13:30 zuwa 17:30 a tsarin h:30. 12:30 yana cikin hutun; 8:30 da 18:30 kuma suna wajen lokutan buɗewa.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta jimlar Turanci ɗaya ko biyu ga abokin da ya ce 'yana buɗe daga 9 zuwa 6, kowane lokaci zai yi': wane lokaci bai dace ba, kuma me ya sa?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Wane layin sanarwar abokinka ya tsallake?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Faɗi sa'o'in da ba su dace ba.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Na faɗi sa'ar da ba ta dace ba?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Abokina zai iya tsara ziyara yanzu?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Tsakanin 12 da 1 yana hutawa (쉬어요), kuma kafin 9 ko bayan 6 a rufe yake.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Kada ka zo lokacin cin abincin rana, 12 zuwa 1. Ɗakin karatu yana hutawa a lokacin; saboda haka zaɓi wani lokaci tsakanin 9 da 6.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yana mayar da hankali ga lokacin hutu.

x-k-k1-02.title: Idan an yi ruwa, za a yi fikinik?
x-k-k1-02.topic: Abin da alama ke faɗa da wanda ba ta faɗa
x-k-k1-02.goal: Kwatanta bayanin da aka rubuta da Turanci da sanarwar Koriya ta asali, nemo layin da ya faɗi fiye da sanarwar, sannan ka rubuta ƙa'idar Koriya da kanka.
x-k-k1-02.material:
Wani malami ya manna sanarwa a ƙofar aji:

내일은 소풍 가요.
9시까지 학교에 오세요.
도시락을 가져오세요.
비가 오면 소풍을 안 가요.

Kalmomi: 소풍 = yawon shakatawa/fikinik; 도시락 = akwatin abinci; 비 = ruwan sama; 오다 = zuwa (비가 오다 = ana ruwa); 안 = ba.

Joon ya karanta ta kuma ya rubuta bayanai huɗu da Turanci (a ƙasa).

Ƙarin kalmomi (na mataki na 2): 눈 = dusar ƙanƙara (눈이 오다 = ana dusar ƙanƙara); 공원 = wurin shakatawa.
x-k-k1-02.thinking.0: Duba bayanin a layi-layi bisa asalin tushe
x-k-k1-02.thinking.1: Gano sharadi (“idan”) da aka mayar da shi gaskiya tabbatacciya
x-k-k1-02.prereq.0: Yana iya karanta Hangul da gajerun jimlolin ladabi
x-k-k1-02.prereq.1: Ya taɓa ganin ƙarshen -(으)면 da ma'anar “idan” a jimloli masu sauƙi
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.prompt: Ɗaya daga cikin bayanan Joon ya faɗi fiye da sanarwar. Wane layi ne?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta kowane bayani da sanarwar, layi ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wane bayani ya tabbatar da abu da sanarwar ta gabatar a matsayin sharadi kawai?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.0: Gobe ita ce ranar yawon shakatawa.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.1: Dole mu kasance a makaranta kafin ƙarfe 9.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.2: Za mu zo da akwatin abincin rana.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.3: Gobe za a yi ruwa, saboda haka ba za a yi yawon shakatawa ba.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne matsalar. Sanarwar ta faɗi abin da ke faruwa idan aka yi ruwa (비가 오면); ba ta ce za a yi ruwa ba. Joon ya mayar da sharadi zuwa hasashe.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.prompt: Wata sanarwa kuma, da Turanci: "If it snows tomorrow, we do not go to the park." Rubuta wannan ƙa'idar da Koriya (salon ladabi -요), ta amfani da kalmomin da ke sama.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Waɗanne sassa biyu dole ne su kasance a cikin jumlar: sharadi da abin da ke faruwa?
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Duba cewa jumlarka ba ta ce lallai za a yi dusar ƙanƙara ba.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jumlar tawa tana da 'if it snows' maimakon 'it snows' kaɗai?
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ta faɗi sakamakon game da wurin shakatawa?
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Salon magana mai ma'ana iri ɗaya.

x-k-k1-10.topic: Abin da alama ke faɗa da wanda ba ta faɗa
x-k-k1-10.prereq.0: Za ka iya karanta gajerun jumlolin Hangul
x-k-k1-10.title: An ƙare apples. Pears fa?
x-k-k1-10.goal: Raba abin da gajeriyar alama ta faɗa da abin da ka zato, sannan ka zaɓi tambayoyin da za su warware abin da ba a sani ba.
x-k-k1-10.material:
A ƙofar shagon 'ya'yan itace (fitilu a kunne, wata mata tana jera kwalaye a ciki) akwai alama:

사과 다 팔았어요. 내일 오세요.

Kalmomi: 사과 = apple; 배 = pear; 다 = duka; 팔았어요 = an sayar; 내일 오세요 = da fatan ku zo gobe.

Abokinka ya karanta alamar ya rubuta bayanai huɗu (a ƙasa). Kana son sayen pears.
x-k-k1-10.thinking.1: Gano ikirarin da ya wuce abin da alamar ta faɗa
x-k-k1-10.thinking.2: Zaɓar tambayoyin da ke warware abin da ba a sani ba
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.prompt: Ɗaya daga cikin bayanan abokinka ya wuce abin da alamar ta ce. Wanne ne?
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, nuna kalmar alamar da ke goyon bayansa.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Wane bayani ne ya shafi abin da alamar ba ta ambata ko kaɗan ba?
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.0: Alamar ta ce apples sun ƙare.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.1: Saboda haka yanzu shagon ba shi da apples.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka shagon ba shi da pears ma.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.3: Alamar tana roƙon mu mu dawo gobe.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne. Alamar ta ambaci 사과 (apples); ba ta ce komai game da pears (배) ba. Sauran layuka suna cikin sanarwar.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.prompt: Ka shiga ciki ka tambayi matar. Waɗanne tambayoyin Koriya ne za su fayyace ko za ka iya sayen pears yau? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Wace tambaya ce game da pears da yau?
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Wace tambaya ce game da apples ko wata rana?
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.a: Ka tambayi kai tsaye game da pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.b: Apples sun ƙare; saboda haka farashinsu ba ya taimaka wajen pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.c: Ka mayar da alamar zuwa tambaya game da pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.d: Wannan game da gobe ne, ba game da sayen pears yau ba.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.explain: Dukansu 배는 있어요? da 배도 다 팔았어요? suna tambaya game da pears yanzu. Tambayoyin farashin apples ko lokacin buɗewar gobe ba za su warware wannan ba.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.acc.0: Tambayar 배는 있어요? ita kaɗai ta wadatar wajen warware tambayar.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.acc.1: Tambayar 배도 다 팔았어요? ita kaɗai ta wadatar wajen warware tambayar.

Kalmomi: 내일 = gobe; 3시 = ƙarfe 3; 만나요 = (mu) haɗu / mu haɗu.

x-k-k1-04.title: Wa ba shi da lafiya? Saƙonni suna canza amsar

x-k-k1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Wane mutum ya kamata ka ambata a amsarka?

x-k-k1-05.title: Labari iri ɗaya ga aboki da malami

x-k-k1-05.material:
Ka aika wa abokinka wannan saƙo:

나 내일 학교에 못 가. 아파.

Yanzu dole ka faɗa wa malaminka (선생님) abu iri ɗaya a saƙo.

Kalmomi: 내일 = gobe; 학교 = makaranta; 못 가 = ba zan iya zuwa ba; 아파 = (ni) ba ni da lafiya.

x-k-k1-05.s.s1.prompt: Waɗanne sassa na saƙon aboki dole ne su canza idan an rubuta wa 선생님? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.

x-k-k1-05.s.s1.explain: Bayanan (gobe, ba zan iya zuwa makaranta ba, rashin lafiya) sun kasance. Ƙarshen jumla ya zama na ladabi (-요 ko -ㅂ니다), kuma 나 ya zama 저 idan ana magana da malami.

x-k-k1-08.prereq.0: Za ka iya karanta gajerun jumlolin Hangul
x-k-k1-08.title: Ina ne ya dace a cire takalma?
x-k-k1-08.goal: Daidaita alama ɗaya da wurin da wataƙila aka rataye ta, ta amfani da cikakkun bayanai na kowane yanayi, sannan ka lura da abin da alamar ba ta faɗa ba.
x-k-k1-08.material:
Wata alama ta ce: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요.

Kalmomi: 신발 = takalma; 벗다 = cirewa; 들어오세요 = da fatan shigo.

Wurare uku, an bayyana su da kalmomi:
Wuri na 1: shagon takalma. Kwastomomi suna gwada takalma suna tafiya a kan siririn kafet.
Wuri na 2: ƙaramin gidan cin abinci. Wurin cin abinci bene ne na katako da aka ɗaga, da ƙananan tebura. A ƙofar akwai jeren takalma a kan matakin dutse.
Wuri na 3: ɗakin motsa jiki na makaranta. An goge benen katako jiya. Dalibai suna sanya takalman cikin gida masu tsabta a wurin.
x-k-k1-08.thinking.0: Amfani da cikakkun bayanan wurin a matsayin hujjar daidaitawa
x-k-k1-08.thinking.1: Kwatanta wace daidaitawa ce ta fi dacewa
x-k-k1-08.thinking.2: Lura da abin da alama ba ta faɗa ba
x-k-k1-08.prereq.1: Ya san cewa alamu suna magana da mutanen da za su shiga
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane wuri ne ya fi dacewa da wannan alamar?
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane wuri tambaya: mutanen wurin suna tafiya a ƙasa da takalmansu?
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta bayanan bene da abin da mutane ke sakawa a ƙafafunsu a kowane wuri.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka lura cewa kwastomomi suna buƙatar takalmansu a ƙafa ko sun cire su domin gwada nau'i-nau'i; kwatanta da alamar 'siririn kafet'.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi amfani da benen da aka ɗaga da takalman da ke kan matakin a matsayin alamu.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.c: Gogaggen bene dalili ne na kare shi, amma dalibai sun riga sun sa takalman cikin gida masu tsabta; saboda haka ba a buƙatar sosai alamar cire takalma.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.explain: Gidan cin abinci yana da alamun da suka fi fitowa fili (benen da aka ɗaga, takalma a mataki). Ɗakin motsa jiki bai dace sosai ba domin dalibai sun riga sun sa takalma masu tsabta, shagon takalma kuma bai fi yiwuwa ba domin kwastomomi suna gwada takalma.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.prompt: Alamar ta ce kawai: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요. Wace tambaya ce cikin waɗannan alamar BA ta amsawa? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sake karanta alamar, ka yi alama ga abin da take gaya maka ka yi.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sannan ka duba kowace tambaya bisa waɗannan umarnin.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.a: Ka ga alamar ta ce a cire takalma, amma ba ta faɗi inda za a bar su ba.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.o.b: Zan shiga bayan na cire su?
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.b: 들어오세요 tana amsa wannan; alamar tana gaya maka ka shigo.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.c: Ka lura alamar ba ta faɗi komai game da safa ba.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.d: 벗고 tana amsa wannan tambayar kai tsaye.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.explain: Alamar ta amsa 'cire takalma' (벗고) da 'shigo' (들어오세요). Ba ta ce inda za a ajiye takalma ko ko ana buƙatar safa ba.
